snippet.title: Portentum - Launch Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Portentum is the cryptid deck-building auto battler. It launches October 28th in Steam Early Access.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836460/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ea_trailer

Play the demo during Steam Next Fest, October 19-26.

One deck. Every monster. Every culture on Earth has a monster it swears is real. Portentum puts them all in one deck. You draft cryptids from around the world, build them into a team, and send them into battles that play out on their own. Your job is everything that happens before the first die lands.

Hunt for broken combos using cryptids from around the world like Bigfoot, Jimothy, Nessie, and the Chupacabra. If somebody's uncle saw it in the woods in 1973, there's a good chance it's a card in Portentum.

For fans of Slay the Spire, Balatro, Hearthstone and Super Auto Pets.

https://portentum.game

Music by Thomas Thoreau
https://www.thomasthoreau.com/

#deckbuilder #autobattler #cardgame #indiegame #steamnextfest
